description.value: Rusty's Pub is a long-standing neighbourhood pub just off Highway 10 and 177a in Surrey, positioning itself as a community gathering spot with 18 HD screens for sports viewing. The menu is broad and eclectic — spanning Wor Wonton Soup and Yorkshire Puddings to burgers and vegan-friendly edamame — making it a solid fuel stop for cyclists passing through the area. Takeout orders are accepted by phone, and the pub also offers delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at rustyspub.ca confirms Rusty's Pub is an active neighbourhood pub at #101 – 17770 56 Ave, Surrey, BC, with phone (604) 574-5512 and a full food and drinks menu. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by repeated references to 'CALL IN ORDERS FOR TAKE-OUT' and 'ORDER FOR FOOD PICK-UP.' Vegetarian menu items are confirmed (Edamame Beans, Vegetable Fajitas, Spinach Dip, Bruschetta, Quesadilla). No website content mentions bike parking, bike racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no street address — only 'Surrey'; address sourced entirely from website.
OSM record has no phone number; phone sourced entirely from website.
Two different postal codes appear on the website: V3S 1C7 (contact page) vs V3S 1K4 (footer). V3S 1C7 used as it appears on the dedicated contact page.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Rusty's Pub is a legitimate, active food-and-drink stop suitable for touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact to verify bike parking and washroom access is needed before listing.
